Villa Raag — Brand Manual, 2026 Edition 

Brand Manual

2 0 2 6 E D I T I O N

A K A I R A L I A Y U R V E D I C G R O U P B R A N D · A L I G N E D T O T H E G R O U P ' S 2 0 2 6 G U I D E L I N E S · S U P E R S E D E S T H E L A U N C H S H E E T

0 1 · I N T R O D U C T I O N The group's coastal note

Villa Raag is the Kairali Ayurvedic Group's yoga sanctuary on Agonda Beach, South Goa — six rooms, one-on-one practice, and the sea. It stands apart from the group's clinical work: where the Healing Village treats, Villa Raag restores. This manual extends the group's 2026 guidelines to the sanctuary so both identities read as one family, carefully kept.

On the quiet sands of Agonda Beach, Villa Raag keeps six rooms, a heated

saltwater pool and the sea's own rhythm — a sanctuary where every

practice is one-on-one and the day moves at the tide's pace.

T H E B R A N D S T A T E M E N T · C H A P T E R 0 8 G O V E R N S I T S R E G I S T E R

What the 2026 edition does

Aligned to the group

Chapters, semantics and production rules now mirror the Kairali 2026 manual, so agencies work from one system.

Placed in the family

Villa Raag becomes the group's fifth door — its leisure register, beside the Healing Village's clinical one. Chapter 07.

Type mapped for daily work

Vonca, Cabrito Didone and Miller now carry licence-free equivalents, as the group did for its sub-brands. Chapter 05.

Voice written down

The coastal register is codified, and the group's banned-filler list now applies to every Villa Raag sentence. Chapter 08.

0 2 · T H E W O R D M A R K Set once, never re-typeset

Two elements, always placed as artwork: the Vonca capitals with their macron over the double A, and the descriptor line — YOGA SANCTUARY . AGONDA BEACH. Three colourways only.

I N K · D E F A U LT O N L I G H T A G O N D A G O L D · B L U S H G R O U N D S W H I T E · F O R E S T & G O L D G R O U N D S

Clear space

Sanctioned Keep a margin equal to the height of the V on every side. Nothing enters it.

once the full lockup has appeared, and at small sizes.

Never

Re-typeset or re-space it · recolour outside ink, gold and white · stretch, distort or rotate it (0° and 90° only) · add shadows or effects · set it on busy photography — use a colour panel, as the group does · pair it with the

emblem at equal weight; one always leads.

Minimum size

Print: 45 mm wide with the descriptor, 30 mm without. Screen: 220 px with, 140 px without. Below these, use the emblem instead.

Without the descriptor

0 3 · T H E E M B L E M The tide, the sun, the lotus

The emblem gathers the sanctuary into one mark — the tide held in the sun's ring, a lotus bud, and the night's constellation. It supports the wordmark; it never replaces it where the name appears for the first time.

A G O N D A G O L D · L I G H T G R O U N D S B L U S H C O C O N U T · G O L D G R O U N D S W H I T E · F O R E S T G R O U N D S

The roundels

The lockup set inside a blush or Agonda Gold circle — for social avatars, wax seals, stickers and spine marks. The circle keeps the lockup's full clear space; nothing else enters it. Blush roundel on light grounds, gold on dark or photographic ones.

Sizes & space

Minimum 18 mm in print, 64 px on screen; roundels 24 mm / 80 px. Clear space equals a quarter of the emblem's width on every side — the constellation and stars count as part of the mark.

Never

Redraw or crop it · separate the lotus from the ring

· recolour outside the three colourways · rotate it · use it as a repeating pattern at full opacity (watermarks sit at ≤ 8%, as in the group's slides).

0 4 · C O L O U R Warmth from the shoreline

Four anchors, unchanged from launch. The values below are the print reference; digital ramps follow the group's ten-step method in the shared design system.

C0 M7 Y12 K0 Primary · grounds, interiors, roundels

\#D9B98E

C0 M15 Y35 K15 Primary · panels, borders, textures

\#DEBC91 → \#B7916B

B L U S H 4 0 · W H I T E 3 0 · T A N 1 5 · G O L D 1 0 · F O R E S T 5 — O N E G O L D M O M E N T P E R V I E W

Text & the gradient

Forest carries text. Gold text on light grounds uses the darkened step Gold 600 \#8F6D49; the gradient

itself is reserved for artwork, roundels and foil — never for type or thin rules.

Semantics, inherited

Digital surfaces borrow the group's semantic pair: \#BE202E means error, \#26265F means information.

Neither appears decoratively at Villa Raag.

0 5 · T Y P O G R A P H Y Three faces, one calm page

Vonca speaks in capitals, Cabrito Didone in display sizes, Miller in the running text. As the group did for its sub-brands, each licensed face now carries a Google-face equivalent for digital and unlicensed work — this manual is set in them.

A G O N D A B E A C H

Capitals only, tracked wide. Overlines, descriptors, small labels — never body text.

Vonca Display capitals · logo-adjacent Maps to Julius Sans One

Mornings keep the tide's time

Headlines, pull quotes, menus and room names. Regular only, never bolded — like Kurale at the group.

Cabrito Didone Display serif · h1–h3 Maps to Prata

Every practice at Villa Raag is one-on-one — Hatha and Vinyasa on the sand, restorative sessions at the pavilion, breathwork as the light

goes. Semibold for labels, italic for programme names.

Miller Family Text serif · body, captions, data Maps to Source Serif 4, 300–700

The working hierarchy

O V E R L I N E · V O N C A 9 – 1 1 Headline · Cabrito Didone

Body · Miller 10–12 pt, leading 1.6.

Caption · Miller 8–9 pt, or Vonca caps for data lines

Licences

The licensed faces keep their printed use where

installed. Digital work, partner decks and unlicensed desks substitute the mapped Google faces — free, embeddable, and recorded in the group's design-system tokens. The wordmark is never affected: it is artwork, not type.

0 6 · P H O T O G R A P H Y Coastal light, unstaged

Professional photography only, in the place's own light. People appear in real practice, not posed; rooms are shot as they are kept. Warm natural colour is the default treatment.

Practice — beach or pavilion

or browse files

P R A C T I C E · N AT U R A L C O L O U R T H E P L A C E · G O L D E N H O U R D E T A I L · R O O M S & T E X T U R E S

Natural warm colour

The default — practice, rooms, food, the shore. True to the light it was taken in.

The place — pool, sea, palms

or browse files

Quiet detail — rooms, textures

or browse files

Golden hour

For heroes and covers — first and last light on the sand, the pool, the pavilion.

Blush overlay

When an image only supports — Blush Coconut, multiply, reduced opacity. The group's overlay method, in Villa Raag's tint.

Never

Cool or blue grading · HDR and heavy filters · posed stock-look wellness shots · cluttered frames · text over

faces · black & white (that treatment belongs to the group's editorial portraits, not the sanctuary).

0 8 · V O I C E The sea's register

Villa Raag speaks with the group's calm — warm, precise, unhurried — tuned to leisure. Short sentences. Real details over adjectives. The sea does most of the persuading.

We say

"Sanctuary", "practice", "one-on-one" · "programme"

for the 7–21-day arcs · named things — Agonda, the

pavilion, the saltwater pool · Title Case headings, sentence-case body · the group credit as chapter 07

sets it.

We never

Borrow KTAHV's clinical vocabulary — patient,

physician, cure · promise outcomes; we describe

practice · shout, exclaim or use emoji · use the group's banned filler: bespoke, curated, discerning,

unparalleled, nestled, indulge, pamper, exquisite,

world-class, unique.

Rewrites — the register at work

I N S T E A D O F S AY

Nestled amidst the tranquil beauty of South Goa… On the quiet sands of Agonda Beach…

Indulge in a unique, curated wellness journey. A programme built around you, one session at a time.

World-class luxury awaits\! Six rooms, the pool, and the sea to yourselves.

A caption, for instance

"Low tide, first light. This morning's practice moved to the sand."

Naming the programmes

Joint Revival (14–21 days) · Mind Renewal (7–10) · Metabolic Reset (10–14) — always with their spans, always as programmes, never as treatments.

0 9 · A P P L I C A T I O N S & S T A T I O N E R Y The sanctuary in hand

Villa Raag prints on the group's stationery programme — same stocks, same weights — foiled in gold rather than the group's finishes. Only personal details change on cards; the layout never does.

V I S I T I N G C A R D , 9 × 5 . 5 C M — B L U S H F R O N T, F O R E S T B A C K

I T E M S T O C K W E I G H T S I Z E

Visiting card Cordenons Wool Ivory · gold foil 250 gsm 9 × 5.5 cm

Letterhead Cordenons Natural Evolution Ivory 120 gsm A4 · 21 × 29.7 cm

Envelope Cordenons Natural Evolution Ivory 145 gsm closed 22 × 10.8 cm

Guest notecard Deo Matte · blind emboss emblem 300 gsm A6 · 10.5 × 14.8 cm

Sanctioned finishes

Gold foiling — the gradient's press form · blind embossing (the emblem) · spot UV · frosted vinyl · 3D signage on forest green or dark wood · jute and fabric printing for retreat kit.

Single-colour renderings

Forest green, ink, or blind/foil finishes — never partial recolourings, exactly as the group rules. In- villa collateral (menus, room folios, spa cards) stays on blush or ivory stock.

1 0 · D I G I T A L & S O C I A L The sanctuary on screen

Digital work inherits the group's 2026 foundation — spacing, radii, motion, components and accessibility — recoloured to Villa Raag's anchors. Forest leads action here too.

Favicon & app icons

Social · @villaraag

Avatar: a roundel from chapter 03. Posts 1:1 and 4:5, stories 9:16. The lockup sits in a corner with full

clear space, or closes the post as an end frame on The emblem alone, centred at 70% of the tile, on

blush. One gold moment per post; photography per blush or forest. Export 16 / 32 / 180 / 512 px. Never the full lockup.

chapter 06; captions per chapter 08.

villaraag.com & booking

Blush and white grounds; Canacona Forest for links, actions and headers; pill buttons, 16 px card radius and calm ease-out motion from the group's component library. The booking flow keeps the same register — no urgency banners, no countdowns.

Email

Single 600 px column on white, lockup 44 px in the header. System fallback: Georgia for both serifs, letterspaced Georgia capitals for Vonca lines. Forest links, pill buttons. Signatures: name in Prata, role in Vonca caps, contacts in Miller, logo 36 px.

Dark surfaces

Canacona Forest only — never black, never gradients of it. The wordmark inverts to white; descriptors and accents use Agonda Gold's light end \#DEBC91; body text is blush at 90%. South Goa Tan is never used for text on dark grounds.

1 1 · A C C E S S I B I L I T Y & P R O D U C T I O N Compliant by default

Digital work targets WCAG 2.2 AA, as across the group. The soft palette makes the text rule simple: Forest carries words; gold and tan decorate.

C O LO U R PA I R I N G C O N T R A S T W C A G 2 . 2 P E R M I T T E D U S E

Forest on white 10.1 : 1 AA + AAA Body text, actions, links — unrestricted

Forest on Blush Coconut 8.9 : 1 AA + AAA Primary text on brand grounds — unrestricted

White on Forest 10.1 : 1 AA + AAA Dark surfaces — unrestricted

Gold 600 \#8F6D49 on white 4.7 : 1 AA Overlines, small gold text, endorsement lines

Agonda Gold \#B7916B on white 2.9 : 1 Decorative Artwork and rules only; text steps down to Gold 600

South Goa Tan on white 1.9 : 1 Decorative Panels, borders, textures — never text

Digital standards

Touch targets ≥ 44 px · visible forest focus ring on every control · honour prefers-reduced-motion

· form fields always labelled · icons never carry meaning alone — the group's chapter 10, unchanged.

Print production

Anchors print from the CMYK builds in chapter 04; Agonda Gold prefers foil at press — confirm spot matches on proof. 3 mm bleed on all trimmed pieces. Logo minimums per chapters 02–03. Blush may print as a tinted stock instead of ink.
